_comment: English locale for Wordle. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim, and keep the feedback letters G/Y/X unchanged (they are the game's per-letter markers).

_slots.{view}: Neutral rendered letters + G/Y/X feedback (do not translate)

prompt.intro:
Uli na ku tchova Wordle.
Kazima ya {word_length}-litandi kazima kawililiwa. Uli na {num_guesses} matiyo ya ku kazima.
Kwa kazima kila, ku binda kazima kuwa na maboko ya miraba (k.mf., '[apple]').
Kulungwana kwa kila litandi kuti pwelekedwa kama ifuatavyo:
  - G (ndimba): litandi lili sahihi pa nafasi sahihi
  - Y (njano): litandi lili mu kazima lakini pa nafasi yasiyo sahihi
  - X (siyo): litandi siyo mu kazima
Leka kazima yako ianze.

invalid.wrong_format: Uli jaribu ku tuma kazima mu fomu yasiyo sahihi. Leka uwe na uhakika wa kutumia maboko ya miraba.
invalid.wrong_length: Kazima yako lazima iwe na {word_length} litandi haswa.
invalid.already_guessed: Uli tayari kubahatisha '{word}' hapo awali. Leka ujaribu kazima nyingine.

feedback.submitted:
Uli tuma [{word}].
Kulungwana:
{view}
Uli na {guesses_left} matiyo yaliyosalia.

outcome.win: Hongera! Uli bahatisha kazima kwa usahihi!
outcome.turn_limit:
Mwisho wa zamu umefikiwa. Uli kushindwa kubahatisha kazima, lakini bahatisho lako bora liliendana na {pct}% ya litandi mu nafasi sahihi.
Kazima ya siri ilikuwa: **{secret}**.
